correctness.rationale: The eight-offset neighbor count yields the stated local map on four column symbols. A 16-state (ordered two-column) transfer graph with 23 edges and a 256-state (ordered four-column) two-step graph with 223 edges encode all periodic strings at any n>=3. Exact independent directed SCC construction found the one-step cyclic components 00, 03/30, 11/12/21/22 and the six two-step cyclic components: the same three fixed components plus rotations of 0033, 0132, 0231. Their length-four cycles contribute exactly twelve distinct configurations iff 4|n. The four-node fixed transfer block has characteristic polynomial (z²-z-1)(z²-z+1), proving the Lucas/trigonometric trace formula. Independent direct eight-offset state enumeration for n=3..8 reproduces counts (fixed: 3,9,13,23,31,49; fixed-after-two: 3,21,13,23,31,61). The displayed X_j traveler updates to a four-cell shape then translates by -2 after two steps; odd returns are excluded by cell count and the translation of the three-cell shape is free.
